findings.issue: The product document states that if a complaint is rejected, the app tells the borrower the decision is final; borrowers are not told they can escalate to the RBI Ombudsman through the CMS portal.
findings.doc_evidence: If a complaint is rejected, the app tells the borrower the decision is final; borrowers are not told they can escalate to the RBI Ombudsman through the CMS portal.
findings.fix: The product must inform borrowers that they can escalate unresolved complaints to the RBI Ombudsman through the CMS portal.

findings.issue: The product document states that members' names, phone numbers and loan amounts are sent to an insurance company without the borrower's consent.
findings.doc_evidence: Members' names, phone numbers and loan amounts are sent to an insurance company so it can call them with micro-insurance offers. Borrowers are not asked before this is shared.
findings.fix: The product must obtain explicit consent from borrowers before sharing their personal information with third-party service providers, including insurance companies.

findings.issue: The product document states that Sakhi Digital has no privacy policy on its website and plans to publish one next year.
findings.doc_evidence: Sakhi Digital has no privacy policy on its website; it plans to publish one next year.
findings.fix: The product must have a comprehensive privacy policy publicly available on its website immediately, in compliance with applicable laws and RBI guidelines.

findings.issue: The product document does not explicitly mention that the LSP (Sakhi Digital) has designated a nodal grievance redressal officer.
findings.doc_evidence: Complaints go to a named nodal officer at the bank and at Sakhi Digital.
findings.fix: The product must explicitly state that Sakhi Digital has designated a nodal grievance redressal officer for digital lending-related complaints.
